$comment: Machine-readable inventory of the Apple Search Ads / Apple Ads APIs. 'endpoints' lists every GET endpoint (all implemented); 'excluded' lists every non-GET endpoint that is intentionally not implemented. tests/unit/api-coverage.test.ts cross-checks this file against src/apple-search-ads/endpoints. Regenerate docs/API-COVERAGE.md with `npm run docs:coverage`.

policy.statement: This MCP server only supports Apple Search Ads GET APIs. Report-generation APIs and other endpoints requiring POST are intentionally excluded, even when they only read data.

campaign-management-v5.name: Apple Search Ads Campaign Management API (Apple Ads Campaign Management API)
campaign-management-v5.status: Deprecated by Apple; sunset on 2027-01-26 in favour of the Apple Ads Platform API
campaign-management-v5.authentication: OAuth 2.0 client credentials: ES256 client-secret JWT (iss=teamId, sub=clientId, aud=https://appleid.apple.com, exp<=iat+180d, kid=keyId) exchanged at POST https://appleid.apple.com/auth/oauth2/token (scope=searchadsorg) for a 1-hour Bearer token

headers.X-AP-Context: orgId={orgId} - required on every endpoint except GET /acls and GET /me

campaign-management-v5.responseEnvelope: { data, pagination: { totalResults, startIndex, itemsPerPage } | null, error: { errors: [ { messageCode, message, field } ] } | null }
campaign-management-v5.pagination: GET list endpoints take limit (default 20, max 1000 for most objects) and offset (default 0) query parameters
campaign-management-v5.rateLimits: No numeric limits published; 429 when exceeded; Apple recommends exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s, 16s cap)

platform-v1.name: Apple Ads Platform API
platform-v1.authentication: Same OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow as v5 (scope=searchadsorg, 1-hour Bearer token)

headers.X-AP-Context: adAccountId={adAccountId} - required except Get User ACLs, Get Me, Get Org by ID, Get Advertiser Resources (and POST /ad-accounts)

platform-v1.responseEnvelope: { result, pagination?: { offset, pageSize, totalCount }, error?: { code, message, details: [ { code, message } ] } }
platform-v1.pagination: Most list reads are POST /query with body pagination; the GET search endpoints take offset + limit/pageSize query parameters
platform-v1.errors: 400 bad_request, 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 429 rate_limit_exceeded, 500 internal_server_error
platform-v1.rateLimits: RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset (seconds) on every response; 429 includes Retry-After (seconds); exponential backoff up to 16s
